occasion.name: Election Day in the United States

meta.title: What if listening never ends in agreement? | Prayer for the One I Cannot Persuade
meta.description:
A spoken prayer for the end of a conversation that did not bring two people to the same place. It offers plain words for refusing without contempt, and for leaving a disagreement honestly unsettled.

For Election Day, and any day people who disagree must choose together: a prayer for hearing each other truly and keeping dignity after the choice.

A prayer for disagreement that remains after honest listening, asking for accuracy, restraint, and care without requiring agreement or renewed trust.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-one-i-cannot-persuade
